key_point: The fighter who was only a rumor
title: The fighter who was only a rumor
caption: Ermac started as a fake character fans believed was real. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #mortalkombat #midway

instagram.caption:
Ermac began as a rumor. In the first Mortal Kombat's diagnostic menu was the word ERMACS, short for error macro.

Fans decided it was a hidden red ninja and spread fake sightings and screenshots across arcades and magazines.

Midway teased it for years, then made Ermac a real playable fighter in Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3. The fans willed him into existence.

Did you believe in Ermac?
